extraction.Name: William McCloskey
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 27, 1918, by F. C. O'Halleren
extraction.Buyer: William and Mary McCloskey conveyed the land by deed to Frank C. O'Halleren for $3500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612452 issued; Southwest quarter section 14, township 98, north of range 77; receipt for the patent was signed February 6, 1918 by the allottee; On April 4, 1918 the patent was recorded; document dated 1929
